description: This is a minimalist pendant light featuring a simple, cylindrical ceiling mount in a pale yellow-green hue. A thin, reddish-brown rod extends downwards from the mount, transitioning into a longer, slender off-white or very light green rod. The light culminates in a smooth, spherical lampshade in a vibrant magenta color. The design is clean and contemporary, with no visible complex details or textures, suggesting a modern aesthetic.
